control_profile: downward volatility scaling, drawdown brakes, close-confirmed loss stop and one-way turnover cap
falsifier: The fixed reversal sign is nonpositive after doubled costs, is concentrated in a few shocks, or loses its edge when the three-day cohorts replace daily whole-book turnover.
formation_horizon: three completed bars measured against a sixty-three-bar causal reference window
hypothesis: A large market-residual move accompanied by abnormal activity and aligned taker pressure reflects temporary liquidity demand and partially reverses after the next executable open.
rebalance_horizon: one daily cohort with three equally weighted overlapping cohorts
